See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oscarvasquezroncal/cuanta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for scope and verification expectations.

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you want and a concrete example.

## Acceptance criteria

How would you tell that the feature works? Include affected engines or operating systems.

## Alternatives and scope

What have you tried? What should this request leave unchanged?
